results.description:
Nuclear war devastated the world just days before Christmas. The desperate normals who barely managed to survive must now make a choice. Do they join the dangerous magic users, or do they kill them all? One choice will save the future. The other will finish burying it under the nuclear ashes.

The Life After War Series
•    A constant battle for survival against man, nature, self, and the forces of evil.
•    Trips into decaying cities where horrors of the past stalk their every move.
•    Normals vs magic users who want to enslave the post-apocalyptic world.
•    Complex villains, anti-heroes, forbidden desires, star-crossed lovers.
•    Flawed characters, betrayals, sabotage, terror, jealousy, insanity.
•    Heroes with awful secrets that might cost them everything.
•    A final battle that will determine the fate of everyone.

"The end of the world has given humanity a harsh, merciless existence, where nature tries hard to push us over the brink of extinction. Everything is against us, between us. Untold miles of lawless, apocalyptic roads wait for our feet, and the future, cold and dark, offers little comfort. Without change, there can be no peace–only survivors."

Winner of the 2025 MAXY Award!
